# Quota

> Quota is a free accountability app for small groups of friends. Each group sets one daily goal, everyone posts a photo or a clip of up to ten seconds as proof before midnight, and the group keeps a streak together. This address (app.hitquota.app) is the app itself; it installs to the home screen on iPhone and Android.
